Sir '''Deris Panteer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of [[House Panteer]]'s [[Queensguard]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Deris and the Queensguard were on the search for the [[Panteer crown|royal crown of Panteer]] until the Panteer Royal Transport crashed in the [[Glarus Valley]]. After tasking a traveler take the crown from the wreckage and delivering it to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lieber]] at the Panteer hideout, Deris slowly died from his wounds.<ref name="The Head" />
